newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Stone accumulate repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Stone accumulate repeated.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Sherman Chao on Tuesday reiterated a rating of accumulate for the intermediate term on Stone Container Corp.

-- "We expect price increases to be successfully implemented for the company's major businesses (linerboard and newsprint) in coming months and Stone should benefit disproportionately due to its large operating leverage," Chao said in a report.
-- Chao noted that the paper company on Monday reported a 1996 Q4 loss of $0.89, "lower than our forecast of a loss of $0.53."
His estimates are for a loss of $1.75 a share for 1997 and profit of $1.25 a share in 1998.
